blocked_by.why: R6 supplies the unbounded closure but §2.3 restriction 2 makes it STRUCTURAL ONLY — there is no constraint that hop i+1's vt_s exceed hop i's, which is exactly `path-temporal-ordering`; and a global maximum-length chain is an optimization, not a scan. Both are §1.4 path-family non-goals. §2.3 states in terms that R6's unbounded Expand is deliberately NOT `temporal_reachability`.
